Look through our examples of Computer Science dissertation topics to help inspire and motivate your own research planning.

Fairness-Aware Deep Learning Models for Dynamic Insurance Pricing

Study methods for identifying biases in pricing models that use demographic and behavioural data and mitigating them. Consider integrating explainability tools (like SHAP, LIME) to grant full transparency to high-stake decision-making.

Federated Learning for Privacy-Preserving Risk Assessment in Health Insurance

To develop a federated learning environment whereby multiple healthcare institutions are able to train AI models without sharing sensitive information. Understand the implications for prediction accuracy and regulatory compliance (GDPR).

NLP-Based Compliance Framework for Real Estate Contracts and Lease Agreement

Create an NLP pipeline for legal purposes for the automatic extraction, analysis and flagging of real estate documents for regulatory violations utilizing either Legal-BERT or GPT-4 fine-tuned on relevant lease clauses

Multimodal AI Models for Property Valuation and Appraisal in Real Time

Using deep learning, this model may combine property images, listing texts, and geolocations for precise and fully explainable valuation. (CNN + Transformer)

Computer Vision and Drone-Based AI for Automated Inspection of Insurance Claims

To develop a computer vision + drone-based AI-generated image system that detects property damage, classify severity and points to next steps reducing processing time to settle insurance claims.

AI-Driven Dynamic Rental Pricing: Real-Time Demand Forecast Model for Smart Cities

Creating AI models in which rental prices are adjusted on-the-fly based on real-time local event data, weather conditions, transportation technology analytics, and general market conditions.

Differentially Private AI for Energy Optimization in Smart Buildings

Design an AI model that performs energy optimization in smart buildings considering IoT data while preserving user privacy through differential privacy mechanisms.

Creating Explainable AI Interfaces for Human-Centered Risk Assessment in Insurance

To achieve human-AI collaboration, interactive and explainable dashboards must be built for underwriters using XAI techniques. Test them with respect to usability, transparency, and trust in decision-making.

Cross-Domain Transfer Learning for Predictive Maintenance for Commercial Buildings

Predictive maintenance would be realized within one domain (e.g., for offices, HVAC); however, it can be adapted to another domain under the paradigm of domain adaptation or transfer learning.

AR/VR + AI for Immersive Experience for Property Viewing and Property Customization

Design an AI-assisted AR/VR real estate system that modifies the virtual tours based on dynamics of user behaviour, user preferences, and affordability analysis.
